messages:
mina: Heads-up — publish RC failed after automated codegen. The generated client swapped parameter order for `login(token, opts?)` -> `login(opts?, token)` and the sample app's retry middleware treats the second arg as token. Local smoke: `yarn regen && yarn workspace js-client test:smoke` -> `Error: auth token missing`

raj: Oh no. Was package bumped by the bot?

mina: yes, package.json 0.3.7 -> 0.4.0 in PR #9012 (autogen/codegen-3456789012). regen-bot suggested minor. publish-bot already attempted to enqueue.

tia: This is the same category of bug we've seen — accidental signature reordering in generated typings breaking runtime assumptions. Quick fix is to make the retry middleware find token by header name not by positional index. I'll open a small hotfix.

regen-bot: autogen summary for 3456789012: 3 files changed (client, types, package.json). Suggested semver: minor. Link: https://git.redwood/PR/9012

mina: Hotfix PR #9013 opened to restore name-based token lookup in retry middleware and add a unit asserting header lookup by name. Running sample-app smoke now.

raj: For medium-term: add a pre-merge check that blocks bot PRs which change package.json.version unless a `codegen:semver` label is present AND a human-written CHANGES entry exists. Also add an AST-level public API comparator to surface signature reorders.

tia: Agreed. I'll prototype a GH Action that 1) detects autogen PR, 2) diffs exported TS declarations, and 3) requires either a maintainer label or a CHANGES mention before allowing merges. ETA: today.

publish-bot: publishflow: blocked for PR #9012 — missing CHANGES.md explanation for version bump.

mina: Local smoke passed after hotfix revert. I'll keep #9013 WIP until the GH Action is in place, then we'll re-run regen in a manual PR and make any intentional API changes explicit with changelog and reviewers.

raj: Nice. Also add a note to devex runbook on how to triage regen-induced auth issues and standard rollback steps.

tia: Will add runbook entry + GH Action PR. Thanks for quick response everyone.
